Covered: plans list/detail (free vs pro locking), start/stop, 403 on starting a pro plan before purchase, exercises, every plan exercise resolves (105 exercises). minor.issue: RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set, so the webhook returns 503. Fulfilment relies only on the client calling /payments/verify plus reconcile_orders. reconcile_orders only looks at orders from the last 24h (4 max). If the app closes mid-checkout and the user doesn't return within 24h, a captured payment is never delivered.

user_with_purchases and reconcile_orders call the Razorpay API in sequence (up to 4 order_payments calls) on every request while the user has open 'created' orders less than 24h old. This adds latency, and each order is fetched again on every request. Consider throttling (e.g. a last_reconciled_at field) or relying on the webhook.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. expo-video's web VideoView passes the RN style straight to <video>. With only position:absolute plus top/left/right/bottom:0, the replaced element kept its 1280x720 size, so only the top-left corner showed. p.play() ran in the useVideoPlayer setup before a <video> was mounted, so the video stayed paused at t=0. Fix: added width/height 100% to styles.fill, and added useEffect(() => player.play(), [player]). Verified: the video is now 342x192 and plays. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ExerciseDemo.tsx:8-22,56

The country code now defaults to +91. Entering a US test number without changing it shows Clerk's raw 'Identifier is invalid.' message. Show a friendlier message. Reference: /app/frontend/app/sign-in.tsx

rca_of_issue: ExerciseDemo video on web: expo-video VideoView.web.tsx passes StyleSheet.flatten(style) directly as the <video> CSS. An absolutely positioned replaced element does not stretch from left/right/top/bottom, so it uses its intrinsic size. Separately, VideoPlayer.web play() only affects <video> elements that are already mounted, and the useVideoPlayer setup callback runs before VideoView mounts. Mitigation applied: explicit 100% width/height, plus play() after mount.
